conviction_note: Near-nothing: the H1 was effectively pre-released (H1 forecast left untouched on 09-08 after the half had closed), the FY guide was raised on 09-08 and implicitly reaffirmed in the 10-13 lease disclosure one session before the print, so what is left is the unquantified 曽於 battery-sale cancellation and a large in-the-money warrant overhang against a name that has sold three of its last four prints; abs 3.0 x (2*0.47-1) = -0.18, while the findings sum to -0.3 because the small supply negatives are filed at their own sizes and the H1 positive is held near 0 as already guided.

findings.finding: The H1 (Mar-Aug) forecast of ordinary 230m / revenue 8,600m was left unchanged in the 2026-09-08 FY upward revision, filed eight days after the half closed and citing GPU-server sales 'accumulating above the initial assumption', so H1 lands on or modestly above plan and carries little news.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: 2025 H1 print (2025-10-14 17:00, came with a 差異 notice and an FY upward revision): -0.92% close to next close; Q1 2026-07-14 16:00 (ordinary turned positive): -3.55%; FY 2026-04-17 missed its own plan: -12.77% (Yahoo daily closes https://query1.finance.yahoo.com/v8/finance/chart/3083.T?range=2y&interval=1d).
findings.why_not_priced: It is largely priced: the company had H1 almost closed when it chose not to touch the H1 numbers, which the market can read as well as I can. What is not visible is whether revenue clears 8,600m by more than 10% (a 差異 notice), which would at most be a timing beat inside a 75% H2-loaded year.
findings.independence: kabutan's read of the same 09-08 filing ('上期の経常損益は従来予想の2.3億円の黒字を据え置いた') https://kabutan.jp/stock/news?code=3083&b=k202609080001 -- same document, counts once.

findings.finding: The 2026-03-19 sale of the 曽於市 battery station was cancelled on 2026-09-28 with the FY impact 'currently being calculated', and the 10-13 AI-server lease (29億円) may book in FY2028 depending on acceptance timing; the Q2 release is the natural place for either to reach the FY forecast, though the 10-13 notice says the 09-08 forecast is unchanged.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: The one recent print that missed the company's own plan (FY26.02, 2026-04-17) fell 12.77% the next session; the three 2026 upward revisions bought -5.93% (06-03 next day), -3.12% (06-25) and +0.72% (09-08).
findings.why_not_priced: Mostly priced: the stock fell from 1,135 to 1,017 over the three sessions after the cancellation and kabutan headlined it. What remains unpriced is the quantification, and the company's own 10-13 statement that the FY forecast is unchanged makes a cut at this print the minority outcome; the downside tail is wide because this name fell 12.8% the last time it missed its own number.
findings.independence: 10-13 lease disclosure (slip risk to FY2028 and 'no change' to the 09-08 forecast) https://www.release.tdnet.info/inbs/140120261013549564.pdf -- different document, points both ways.

findings.finding: In-the-money warrant supply is ~93% of the share count: 10th warrants 5.87m shares at 971.1 yen (holder exercised 103k in Sept), 9th 2.0m at 1,133 yen just above spot, and Cantor's 8th (2.09m left at 971.1; 882,400 shares exercised in Sept, 2,042,700 new shares in total since 05-31) halted only from 10-12 'until withdrawn', so any post-print rally meets fresh issuance.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: During Cantor's September exercise run (882,400 shares at 971.1 between 09-01 and 09-29) the stock fell from 1,283 (09-10) to 1,068 (09-30); since the 10-05 halt notice it has traded 1,084-1,134.
findings.why_not_priced: Public and partly priced: the halt removed the most active seller, which cuts the other way. What is not in the price is the asymmetry it creates at the print -- upside above ~1,133 is supplied by the 9th and 10th, downside is not supported -- and that only shows if the release is good.
findings.independence: Halt notice https://www.release.tdnet.info/inbs/140120261005545854.pdf (same programme, different document; it points the other way and is netted into this one finding).

findings.finding: Margin long balance is 1.25m shares (10-09), ~12% of shares outstanding and about four days of turnover, with a 信用倍率 of 3.94x on kabutan, though it has halved from 2.94m on 07-31.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: No resolved observation of this line on this name.
findings.why_not_priced: Positioning is public; it matters only as the seller base for a disappointment (the one setup in which a known item still has sellers), and the halving since July says much of it has already been washed out by the -14% 20-day run.
findings.independence: kabutan 信用倍率 3.94x https://kabutan.jp/stock/?code=3083 (different source, same direction).

findings.why_not_priced: Largely priced on 10-13; residual only if the 短信 or auditor wording picks up a disclosure-control point, which I have no evidence of.

Returns: no interim dividend, 優待 already introduced 09-02, nothing expected. New-year guide: n/a (H1). Quarter: H1 forecast held after period-end, so H1 should land near 230m ordinary; Q1 was 23.5% of the H1 ordinary plan and the FY is 75% H2-loaded, so 進捗率 against FY will look low by design.

baseline_tension: The baseline lean is +0.71 (all run-up; no shorts) and the findings are a slight net negative, so they cut mildly against it; the strongest positive the release could carry is a held FY forecast with an H1 revenue beat after a -14% 20-day slide and a halved margin long, which I looked for and judge to be the base case but largely pre-signalled by the 10-13 'no change' statement.
lessons_applied: Rule 1 (a negative resting on a series the market already has): the battery-cancellation finding is public since 09-28 and already sold (1,135 to 1,017), so it moved from -0.4 to -0.2 and p_up from 45 toward 50.

Rule 2 (negatives outnumber positives): wrote the strongest positive (held FY guide, H1 revenue beat, washed-out margin long, Cantor halt) into baseline_tension; netted the Cantor halt into the warrant finding (-0.3 to -0.1) and cut the margin-long finding (-0.2 to -0.1); p_up 45 to 47.
Open question 3 (a prior 業績予想の修正 may kill the event): H1 effectively pre-released and FY revised 09-08, so abs_move_pct cut from 3.5 to 3.0; the H1 finding left at +0.2.
Left standing: the late major-shareholder disclosure at -0.1 and print_vs_bar_pct at +3.0.
